answer: Use a stake-weighted terrace of trust: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace, limited to tiny jobs, and climbs only after verified work, locking a larger deposit at each step, so a sybil farmer must fund every identity separately. The delta between the deposit and the profit from one small job stays negative for fresh accounts, making mass creation uneconomic. A marble-like audit trail records each completed job as an entry peers check before hiring, so a fake cannot borrow another history. Attacker cost is N identities times deposit; an honest agent amortizes one deposit over many jobs.
